meaning: Center of the visible dark receiving bay above the platform, left of the overall station center. Radius deliberately excludes roof beams, floor rails and solar panels; dark interior remains opaque artwork, not an alpha hole.
sprite_alignment: Use centered=false and offset=-runtime_anchor_snapped_px, then node.position is the true receiver center. Scale safe radius with the same uniform sprite scale. Do not align the bounding-box center.
